purpose: Present record metadata as semantic term/value pairs with a deliberate missing-value treatment.
behaviorProvider: Native dl, dt and dd semantics with CSS grid layout; no interaction state.

component: pair terms and descriptions in supplied order
host: interaction behavior inside any supplied ReactNode

requirements.statement: Render a dl with one wrapper containing dt and dd for every supplied item, preserving array order.
Supply a stable unique id per item so React can retain item identity when metadata changes. The component does not detect duplicate ids.
Use emptyValue only for null, undefined or the empty string. Preserve numeric zero; do not convert all falsy values into missing content.
Format booleans or other domain values into meaningful React content before passing them. false is not classified as missing and React renders it without visible text.
An empty items array renders an empty dl rather than an EmptyState or a loading message. emptyValue applies to individual descriptions, not the whole collection.
columns chooses one, two or three top-level tracks and orientation selects stacked or horizontal term/value pairs; these settings do not alter the supplied semantic order.
At the narrow breakpoint, the list collapses its top-level columns to one. Horizontal orientation still uses its paired inner grid, and values allow long content to wrap.

Provide understandable labels and appropriately formatted values; supply named shared controls when a value is interactive. DescriptionList does not infer editable fields, copy behavior or navigation from text.
Own loading, failures and recovery outside the list; keep missing individual values distinct from unavailable entire records. The component has no async state machine.
Use data-display group tokens for term/value typography, spacing and tracks. Preserve native description-list semantics and theme-invariant dimensions when extending the layout.

limitations: No loading/error view, editing behavior or value formatting is provided.
The API exposes className rather than arbitrary root DOM props; outer labeling or region semantics belong to the host.
A missing-value fallback is not applied to false, whitespace-only strings or empty React fragments.
